prompts.A:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: RIVERSIDE_HOME_LANE_CONCEPT_A, original WilliCat world-design review concept, NOT a production mesh or background.
Output canvas MUST be portrait exactly 9:16, e.g. 864x1536 or1080x1920, not2:3. One uninterrupted image, no borders/titles/text/UI.
Depict a possible mobile gameplay area designed as REAL STYLIZED HAND-PAINTED 3D STORYBOOK DIORAMA: true believable volumetric forms, elevated three-quarter orthographic / near-orthographic soft-isometric-lite camera, both roofs/tops and front/side planes visible, no cinematic perspective horizon. Premium matte painted miniature with softened authored profiles, warm clean weathering, broad brush color rather than realistic PBR or a flat painting.
CONCEPT A spatial thesis: intimate HOME RIVERSIDE LANE. A modest one-storey home café has honey cedar beams, cream plaster, a simple charcoal-blue-grey gabled roof, recessed welcoming open entrance, one muted sage cloth awning and a SMALL BLANK sign panel. Two quiet ordinary neighbors, one shopfront and one plaster residence, form a short pedestrian frontage. Calm warm-stone lane broadens slightly into a small café doorstep forecourt and continues in a gentle diagonal alongside a narrow blue-green waterway. Water is close to everyday doorsteps but separated by low warm-gray stone embankment/cap. ONE compact straight wooden pedestrian bridge farther along the lane, both approaches plainly visible. River recedes toward low-contrast distant house/tree/hill masses, no huge town.
Foreground accessible path enters clearly from bottom; midground café/bridge/water; background subdued continuation. Restrained pots at the café entrance and one ceramic planter/bench nook; river reeds only at recesses. One slim drain outlet and everyday utility detail, NOT decorative clutter everywhere. Warm café silhouette has priority over neighbors. Walking strip remains calm, uninterrupted and readable. Trees varied in height and canopy shape, green moss/sage with broad painted masses, no wall of foliage obscuring route.
Palette family: cedar #C68F5E/#9B6D44/#583F2E, cream plaster #F3DEC7, warm-gray stone related#CAAF93, moss#768658/sage#526F4E, river#80BABA/#50979F/#3B727E, subdued blue-gray roof. Small aged brass and off-white ceramic accents, no saturation wash. Neutral soft daylight, soft contact/cast shadows, broad ambient fill, tactile dimensional handcrafted atmosphere. No bloom, fog, vignette, shallow DOF, dramatic golden hour, glossy water, heavy toon outline.
No characters at all: existing canonical protagonist is separate authority and must not be regenerated. No text, logos, symbols, kanji, torii, pagodas, shrines, temple, red lantern clusters, cherry blossom carpet, bamboo themepark, copied game design, strict diamond tile grid, cut-off giant foreground objects. Entire scene sharp/readable at phone gameplay scale. Original neighborhood; do not reproduce one Japanese location.

MASTER SYNTHESIS — do not reproduce one previous concept: intimate home frontage of a narrow lane + a slight river bend + an everyday neighborhood crossing. Raise the camera enough to show walkable ground topology, no horizon line or vanishing-point perspective, keep everything sharp. Compose a compact architectural game area occupying most of frame: center-left one modest SINGLE-STORY Home Café with a shallow cedar roof, warm cream plaster, thick window sill, one plain muted sage awning and a strongly visible OPEN WALK-IN door facing a small paved forecourt. Calm curving home street rises from bottom-center past this forecourt to upper-left, with one side-path exit. On the right a NARROW blue-green river bends gently from lower-right to upper-right; it occupies less than about a third of the image, not a huge lake. A compact nearly-flat pedestrian cedar bridge crosses at mid-right, BOTH stone approach landings and a connected far-bank walking path visible INSIDE the frame. Bridge rails use a distinctive paired short vertical brace and low broad top cap with gentle notched ends, original modest handmade character. Far bank has one ordinary cream-and-wood small storefront and one simple residential frontage, subtly different age and roof proportions, not an elaborate historic town. A right-side path and an upper path suggest future routes rather than dead ends. Use soft hill/tree silhouettes and only two distant house roofs in the quiet upper background, no deep cinematic vista. Foreground path is open and comfortable; one bench and compact lamp are outside travel strip, a low pot cluster beside café entrance, small and medium trees varied silhouette in TWO planted clusters. Architecture frames a small living neighborhood, not a huge empty floor. Exactly three clear depth bands and simple landmark hierarchy: café entrance first, bridge second, path branching third. No flowers covering paving, no clutter, no giant Japanese ornamental motifs. Painterly tactile materials, volumetric softened edges, broad color masses, fair neutral daylight.
